idea.motivation: The user diagnosis identifies stale or isolated historical evidence and broad, weakly supported matches as distinct failures. ## Insights and directions

The starting evidence suggests three priorities. Electronics has 14.95% sampled wrong rankings and a −0.4812 tenth-percentile margin, motivating better candidate discrimination; these diagnostics do not establish validation HR@10. Users report stale-history influence and broad, weakly supported matches, motivating explicit recent behavioral support. Embedding similarity near 0.54 provides little evidence of severe collapse, weakening the case for diversity regularization.

        # Keep only valid catalog IDs in the exclusion mapping.

            u: ids[(ids >= 1) & (ids <= itemnum)] for u, ids in self.excluded.items()
        }
        self.rank_thresholds = {
            u: ids - np.arange(len(ids), dtype=np.int64) - 1
            for u, ids in self.excluded.items()
        }
        self.user_rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

            )

            self.reduced += length * (k < num_negatives)

                ranks
                + 1

            neg[b, -length:, :k] = draws

    def analyze_embeddings_collapse_cosine(

        emb = self.model.item_emb.weight.detach()[1:]
        k = min(int(sample_size), emb.size(0))

        generator = torch.Generator(device=emb.device)

            )
